name: holdout_session_expiry_reversal
description: An authentication session is valid only while now is earlier than expires_at; integers represent epoch seconds.

name: holdout_audit_key_exposure
description: Audit entries must not include the raw API key. The returned message is written to the login audit log.

name: holdout_upload_traversal
description: Reject absolute POSIX paths and names whose normalized path escapes the upload root; accept ordinary relative paths.

name: holdout_money_rounding
description: Price conversion must round decimal amounts to the nearest cent using ROUND_HALF_UP rather than truncate.

name: holdout_unique_identity_count
description: The function counts distinct user IDs, not the total number of rows.

name: holdout_tenant_cache_collision
description: Cache entries for objects in separate tenants must be isolated, even if object IDs are equal.

name: holdout_safe_invoice_prefix
description: Input is a string. Checking a four-character prefix with slicing is equivalent to startswith.

name: holdout_safe_demorgan
description: Both inputs are booleans. De Morgan rewrite preserves behavior.

name: holdout_safe_settings_merge
description: Inputs are plain built-in dictionaries; later overrides take precedence. Python 3.9+.

name: holdout_safe_decimal_int_parse
description: Input is a valid signed base-10 integer string. Passing base=10 explicitly is equivalent.

name: holdout_safe_integer_absolute
description: The function receives Python integers (not custom numeric objects). Replacing abs with a sign check preserves values.

name: holdout_safe_strip_mapping
description: For a list of normal strings, list comprehension and map(str.strip, ...) return the same new list.
